title: Review Tauri GTK glib advisory
summary: Re-verified the Tauri/Wry GTK/glib Dependabot chain, attempted the supported Cargo upgrade path in isolation, and documented that the advisory remains blocked upstream without affecting the Windows WebView2 package lane.
reason: Prevent an incompatible glib override while keeping the release decision, Linux exposure, upgrade trigger, and review deadline current.
behavior_before: The active records listed the older locked versions and a general upstream-blocked posture without the latest compatible resolver result, advisory function scope, or explicit Linux promotion posture.
behavior_after: The active records identify the advisory, exact locked and latest compatible chains, Windows versus Linux reachability, reduced-but-not-proven direct-use exposure, the no-override rule, and a 2026-08-07 re-review deadline.
manual_validation: An isolated cargo update resolved tauri 2.11.5 and tauri-runtime-wry 2.11.4 but retained wry 0.55.1, gtk 0.18.2, and glib 0.18.5.
Current upstream Tauri, tauri-runtime-wry, and Wry dev manifests still require GTK 0.18.
Packet JSON, required documented evidence fields, the local review link target, and unchanged Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock were validated.
Static scans found no VariantStrIter references in current Tauri, tauri-runtime-wry, Wry, or GTK sources.
cargo check --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc passed for the repository lock.
cargo tree --locked for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc confirmed GTK/glib are Linux-target-only while Wry is cross-platform.
rollback_plan: Revert only the #15 checklist text and the advisory sections added or updated in the two dependency inventories; no manifest or lockfile changed.
